Title: Nikhil's Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Siya - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Shalini - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Ajay - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Siya, Shalini and Ajay stand near him.]

Siya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil plays cricket in the park.]

Nikhil: "Okay, Dad."

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Nikhil does push-ups.]

Nikhil (softly): "That was fun!"

[Nikhil does yoga on a mat.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[Siya skips rope.]

Siya: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Shalini, Ajay and Siya stand near him.]

Nikhil: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil takes the bag from Mother.]

Shalini: "That's easy."

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Siya: "Nikhil, look at this."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Nikhil (happily): "Show me too!"

[Flower petals rain down on Nikhil.]

Siya (laughing): "I'm ready!"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Shalini: "One more time!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Shalini and Ajay stand near him.]

Ajay: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil opens the door and goes out.]

Nikhil: "Really?"

[Nikhil slams the door shut.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Siya stands in the living room. Nikhil, Shalini and Ajay stand near her.]

Ajay: "Nikhil, look over here."

[Siya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Shalini: "Okay, Nikhil."

[Nikhil sips hot tea from a cup.]

Siya (gently): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil does his homework at the table.]

Siya (softly): "Okay, Nikhil."

[Nikhil watches cartoons on TV.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
